items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: So I hired him and for two years I had Dinah Washington and Joe Williams for a boy and girl singer.

ctx.x: Yeah. He’s a good organist too.
Yeah. A great organist. And let me see here. Oh, Joe Williams?
Joe Williams? There’s a name we like.

items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Right. You toured with Lionel Hampton.

ctx.x: Red Saunders and the DeLisa. Did you learn a great deal —
Andy Kirk. We were playing for dancing even then. And Lionel Hampton too.
Right. You toured with Lionel Hampton.
